The query joins all Montgomery tracts to 2025 code-violation counts and CDC adult high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation with paired tract count.
sql:
WITH violation_counts AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(n) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_b8703e' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
health AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_b8703e_m2_cdc
  WHERE countyfips = '01101' AND stateabbr = 'AL'
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
  COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
  h.totalpopulation,
  h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR((COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0, h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS code_violation_vs_hbp_correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN violation_counts v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
  AND h.totalpopulation > 0
  AND h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, t.name
LIMIT 200
